description: You are an Architect at Inclusive Learning Spaces LLC, designing an ADA-compliant multi-purpose classroom for a community college continuing-education wing. The building shell is open in Sweet Home 3D. Design a classroom that accommodates 24 students while meeting accessibility standards. Create partition walls to define the instructor area, student seating zone, resource alcove, and a staff preparation area. Install doorways for wheelchair access between zones. Add dimension line annotations to document key clearance widths for the ADA code review. Furnish every area for its intended educational use -- student desks and chairs, instructor station, resource shelving, restroom fixtures. Use only Sweet Home 3D's built-in catalog. Save the file when complete.
